description: Computes grid-based declustering weights by measuring each sample's influence on evaluation locations. Supports both KNN (arithmetic mean) and IDW (inverse-distance weighted) modes via an optional power parameter.

object.description: Spatial locations of samples to compute declustering weights for.
object.title: Sample Locations

grid.description: The evaluation grid for measuring sample influence.

object.description: Regular grid or set of evaluation locations used to measure each sample's spatial influence.
object.title: Evaluation Grid

grid.title: Grid

target.description: The target object and attribute to write declustering weights to.

object.description: Object to write the declustering weight attribute onto. Typically the same object as the source.
object.title: Weight Output Target

attribute.description: Name of the attribute to create or update with the computed declustering weights.

operation.description: The operation to perform on the attribute.
operation.title: Operation

name.description: The name of the attribute to create.
name.title: Name

operation.description: The operation to perform on the attribute.
operation.title: Operation

reference.description: Reference to an existing attribute to update.
reference.title: Reference

attribute.title: Declustering Weights

target.title: Target

neighborhood.description: Search neighborhood parameters. The search ellipsoid and sample limits control which samples influence each grid location during the estimation used to compute declustering weights.

ellipsoid.description:
The ellipsoid, to search for points within
Alias: anisotropy

major.description: The major axis length of the ellipsoid
major.title: Major

semi_major.description: The semi major axis length of the ellipsoid
semi_major.title: Semi Major

minor.description: The minor axis length of the ellipsoid
minor.title: Minor

dip_azimuth.description: first rotation, about the z-axis, in degrees
dip_azimuth.title: Dip Azimuth

dip.description: second rotation, about the x-axis, in degrees
dip.title: Dip

pitch.description: third rotation, about the z-axis, in degrees
pitch.title: Pitch

ellipsoid.title: Ellipsoid

max_samples.description:
The maximum number of samples to use for each evaluation point.
Alias: max-samples
max_samples.title: Max Samples

min_samples.description:
The minimum number of samples to use for each evaluation point.
Alias: min-samples
min_samples.title: Min Samples

max_empty_octants.description: The maximum number of empty octants (aka sectors) allowed when searching for neighbors. Omitting this, or a value of 8, disables the octant check.
max_empty_octants.title: Max Empty Octants

max_samples_per_octant.description: The maximum number of samples to use from each octant.
max_samples_per_octant.title: Max Samples Per Octant

max_samples_per_drillhole.description: The maximum number of samples to use from each drillhole (defined by drillhole ID)
max_samples_per_drillhole.title: Max Samples Per Drillhole

max_empty_quadrants.description: The maximum number of empty quadrants (2D sectors, ignoring Z) allowed when searching for neighbors. If not specified, quadrant filtering is disabled.
max_empty_quadrants.title: Max Empty Quadrants

max_samples_per_quadrant.description: The maximum number of samples to use from each quadrant (2D sectors, ignoring Z).
max_samples_per_quadrant.title: Max Samples Per Quadrant

max_drillholes.description:
The maximum number of drillholes to be used in each estimate.
Alias: max_drillholes_per_estimate
max_drillholes.title: Max Drillholes

min_drillholes.description:
The minimum number of distinct drillholes required in each estimate. 0 disables the check. Requires Downhole Intervals.
Alias: min_drillholes_per_estimate
min_drillholes.title: Min Drillholes

drillhole_limit_scope.description: Apply max_samples_per_drillhole globally (the default), independently in each quadrant (ignoring Z), or independently in each octant, in search-ellipsoid coordinates. Requires max_samples_per_drillhole. Limits on the number of distinct drillholes remain global.
drillhole_limit_scope.title: Drillhole Limit Scope

neighborhood.title: ExtendedNeighborhood

power.description: Inverse-distance weighting power. Controls how strongly distance affects influence: higher values give nearer samples more weight. The default (2.0) uses standard inverse-distance-squared weighting. Set to null to use arithmetic-mean KNN (equal neighbour votes, no distance weighting).
power.title: Power

message.description: A message that says what happened in the task.
message.title: Message

target.description: The target that was created or updated with declustering weights.

name.description: The name of the geoscience object.
name.title: Name

description.description: The description of the geoscience object.
description.title: Description

schema_id.description: The ID of the Geoscience Object schema.
schema_id.title: Schema ID

reference.description: Reference to the attribute in the geoscience object.
reference.title: Reference

name.description: The name of the output attribute.
name.title: Name

target.title: Target
